villagemaster/32160.htm.text: Grand Magister Devon: Hmm... are you an adventurer? Come in, come in. What is that you seek from me? Does it concern a class transfer? Or perhaps it relates to the dark voice buried in the light? You know, don't you? There is a light that can only be found by those who live in darkness...

links.text: Ask about the first prior occupation.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
